title: Descended overlap transitions and cartesian intersection lifts
statement: Let $p:X\to Y$ be an fpqc singleton of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering], let $V\to X$ have a transport descent datum $D$ [def-pd-descent-datum], and let $(U_i)_{i\in I}$ be any family of open subschemes of $V$ (not necessarily covering). Suppose $E_i$ is a descent datum on $U_i\to X$, its transports followed by $U_i\to V$ equal the transports of $D$ followed from the same test point, and there are schemes $W_i\to Y$ and maps $q_i:U_i\to W_i$ with cartesian squares over $p$ [def-pc-fibre-product], such that each $q_i$ is invariant under all transports of $E_i$. Then there exist schemes $Z_{ik}$, open immersions $f_{ik}:Z_{ik}\to W_i$ [def-weil-open-immersion], and maps $t_{ik}:Z_{ik}\to Z_{ki}$, with $f_{ii}$ an isomorphism and $t_{ii}$ the identity. There exist maps $t'_{ikl}:Z_{ik}\times_{W_i}Z_{il}\to Z_{kl}\times_{W_k}Z_{ki}$ whose second projection equals the first projection followed by $t_{ik}$, and $t'_{ikl}t'_{kli}t'_{lik}$ is the identity (composition in the order traversed). For each $i,k$ there is a map $r_{ik}:U_i\times_V U_k\to Z_{ik}$ making the square with first projection to $U_i$, $f_{ik}$ and $q_i$ cartesian, and $r_{ik}$ followed by $t_{ik}$ and $f_{ki}$ equals the second projection followed by $q_k$. No ambient scheme or its structure map is asserted.

proof.text: Compatibility with the ambient transport preserves factorization of a test point through any U_k: lift it through the open immersion U_k -> V and compare the transported inclusions using hcompat. For maps a,b into U_i with the same q_i composite, restrict the test scheme to the preimage of U_k under a. The cartesian square and hinv identify transport of a with b. Thus a and b have equal inverse-image opens, by applying containment in both directions. In particular the intersection open satisfies the required equality on U_i times_{W_i} U_i. Base change of p gives an fpqc singleton q_i. Apply unique descent of opens to obtain O_ik. Set Z_ik to its open subscheme and f_ik to the inclusion. Diagonal uniqueness gives O_ii=top and f_ii is an isomorphism. Construct r_ik by the open-immersion lift of the first projection followed by q_i; the equality of inverse-image opens and the pullback projection open range give its cartesian square.

Fpqc representable descent gives EffectiveEpi for every fpqc singleton, using Mathlib fpqcTopology.Subcanonical and the singleton sheaf criterion. Base change of q_i along f_ik makes r_ik such a singleton. Given two test maps into U_i times_V U_k agreeing after r_ik, their U_i projections have equal q_i composites. Cartesian uniqueness identifies transport of the first U_i projection with the second. Compatibility with D and monicity of U_k -> V identify their U_k transports as well. Invariance of q_k then gives equality after the swapped lift r_ki. Define t_ik by EffectiveEpi.desc of the swap followed by r_ki. Its factorization is r_ik followed by t_ik = swap followed by r_ki. Monicity of U_i -> V makes the diagonal swap the identity, so cancelling r_ii gives t_ii=identity. Composing the factorization with f_ki gives the stated second-projection equation.

For P_ikl=Z_ik times_{W_i} Z_il pull back q_i along the common map P_ikl -> W_i to get an fpqc effective epi c:B_ikl -> P_ikl. The two cartesian intersection squares give maps a:B_ikl -> U_i times_V U_k and b:B_ikl -> U_i times_V U_l sharing their U_i projection. Their other projections define d:B_ikl -> U_k times_V U_l. The maps (d followed by r_kl, a followed by swap and r_ki) and (b followed by swap and r_li, d followed by swap and r_lk) define cyclic reordered lifts e and e-prime into P_kli and P_lik. The second projection of e factors through c as the first projection followed by t_ik. Since the second projection of P_kli is monic, e is compatible on every equal-c pair, and EffectiveEpi.desc defines t-prime_ikl with the required projection equation. Monicity of second projections and the pairwise transition factorization show c followed by t-prime_ikl=e, e followed by t-prime_kli=e-prime, and e-prime followed by t-prime_lik=c. Cancel c for the cyclic identity. This proof does not assume that the U_i cover V and works with empty index sets and empty opens.

theorem exists_descended_overlap_glue_data
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {p : X ⟶ Y}
    (hp : Presieve.singleton p ∈ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage Y)
    {V : Over X} (D : Over.DescentDatum p V)
    {I : Type u} (U : I → V.left.Opens)
    (E : ∀ i, Over.DescentDatum p (Over.mk ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom)))
    (hcompat : ∀ (i : I) {T : Scheme.{u}} (f₁ f₂ : T ⟶ X)
      (h : f₁ ≫ p = f₂ ≫ p) (a : Over.mk f₁ ⟶ Over.mk ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom)),
      ((E i).transport f₁ f₂ h a).left ≫ (U i).ι =
        (D.transport f₁ f₂ h (Over.homMk (a.left ≫ (U i).ι)
          (by simpa only [Over.mk_hom, Category.assoc] using Over.w a))).left)
    (W : I → Over Y) (q : ∀ i, (U i).toScheme ⟶ (W i).left)
    (hcart : ∀ i, IsPullback (q i) ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom) (W i).hom p)
    (hinv : ∀ (i : I) {T : Scheme.{u}} (f₁ f₂ : T ⟶ X)
      (h : f₁ ≫ p = f₂ ≫ p) (a : Over.mk f₁ ⟶ Over.mk ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom)),
      ((E i).transport f₁ f₂ h a).left ≫ q i = a.left ≫ q i) :
    ∃ (Z : I × I → Scheme.{u}) (f : ∀ i k, Z (i, k) ⟶ (W i).left)
      (t : ∀ i k, Z (i, k) ⟶ Z (k, i)),
      (∀ i k, IsOpenImmersion (f i k)) ∧
      (∀ i, IsIso (f i i)) ∧
      (∀ i, t i i = 𝟙 _) ∧
      (∃ (t' : ∀ i k l, Limits.pullback (f i k) (f i l) ⟶ Limits.pullback (f k l) (f k i)),
        (∀ i k l, t' i k l ≫ pullback.snd _ _ = pullback.fst _ _ ≫ t i k) ∧
        (∀ i k l, t' i k l ≫ t' k l i ≫ t' l i k = 𝟙 _)) ∧
      (∀ i k, ∃ (r : Limits.pullback (U i).ι (U k).ι ⟶ Z (i, k)),
        IsPullback r (pullback.fst (U i).ι (U k).ι) (f i k) (q i) ∧
        r ≫ t i k ≫ f k i = pullback.snd (U i).ι (U k).ι ≫ q k)
